The '''Monitor Droid TX''' was [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. A number of those droids were patrolling the area around the factory during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />
